text:
Rina Kapoor: CascadeAI reached out to list cascade-15b-open in Marketplace + a joint SI bundle with VectorOps and an HW appliance partner (StoneEdge). They want EU-only hosting for some customers and permission for us to redistribute quantized derivatives to SIs. Target launch ~3 weeks. Thoughts?

Ethan Moore: Marketplace checklist first: SPDX license, model-card, weights sha256, container manifest, perf snapshot. Can we get a confirmed license text from CascadeAI?

Vikram Shah: From Eng-ML: we can produce q4_0/q8_0 variants. If CascadeAI allows redistribution of derived artifacts, Eng-ML can publish quantized weights to SI partners and customers. If not, fallback is hosted inference + SI via API.

Olga Petrova: StoneEdge requires signed OCI images and FIPS-compatible KMS for on-prem installs. Private deployments with BYOK will add provisioning time. Also VectorOps wants an offline image (signed tar) for appliance validation.

legal-bot: Scan result: model-card references mixed-licensed web data. Recommend explicit "Derived Artifacts Distribution" clause with attribution and provenance.json requirement. Also surface any export-control flags; uploading precedent addendum to drive.

Rina Kapoor: Proposed go-to-market: ingest + QA (Eng-Platform, 2 days), quant + perf (Eng-ML, 2 days if q artifacts provided), SI + HW validation (VectorOps/StoneEdge, 5 days), 7-day embargo, co-blog + joint webinar. Can we hit it if license clears in 48h?

Ethan Moore: Yes if license + artifacts arrive fast. I'll prep SKU draft (Hosted / Dedicated / Private-EU) and asset checklist tonight. Need to know whether to list downloadable quant artifacts for customers.

Vikram Shah: If CascadeAI doesn't provide quant artifacts, mark Eng-ML conversion as conditional: +48h. We need redistribution rights in the contract to ship converted weights. Also require provenance headers and a small eval script: run_eval.sh -> outputs perf.json.

Olga Petrova: Ops action: OCI signing + KMS runbook for StoneEdge and an offline bundle guide for VectorOps. That will take ~3 business days to prepare. If partner needs FIPS/HSM certs, add more time.

Rina Kapoor: Responsibility map: Partnerships = partner comms + announcement; Eng-Platform/Ethan = ingest + SKUs; Eng-ML/Vikram = quant + evals; SI/HW/Olga = validation + ops; Legal = draft addendum + export check. Reconvene TOM 9am PT.

legal-bot: Action: draft "Derived Artifacts & Geofencing Addendum v2" and send to Cascade counsel. Flag if any dataset license conflicts.

Ethan Moore: I'll post the SKU draft and a fallback (hosted-only) flow if redistribution blocked.

Vikram Shah: ack, will reserve Eng-ML runway.

Olga Petrova: ack, will begin OCI + KMS docs.

Rina Kapoor: Thanks team :raised_hands: If Cascade pushes back on redistribution, we'll decide: delay to negotiate vs proceed with hosted-only + SI via API. Flag blockers here immediately.
